prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in to keep your desktop pet synced across devices. Existing pet progress and custom companions automatically restore upon login.", "Logged in previously? Use your original sign-in method to restore your existing pet."]
1: []
2: ["Initializing Desktop Companion", "Your pet is currently being rendered onto your desktop background. You can safely minimize this window.", "Initialization active. Look for your companion on your main screen shortly."]
3: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Adopt a ready-to-go companion instantly or build a personalized pet using your own photos."]
4: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime for quick controls, or access full settings from your system tray.", "Right-click pet for actions • System tray holds settings • Drag pet anywhere on screen"]
5: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Select between instantly adopting a pre-made pet or generating a custom companion from your photos.", "Continue"]
6: ["Review Your Selected Companion", "Take a quick moment to verify your companion choice before creating their official adoption certificate.", "Confirm & Continue"]
7: ["Can't see your pet? Check your system tray (near the taskbar clock) to bring your desktop companion to the front."]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion in Seconds", "Add a friendly interactive pet to your desktop screen. Choose or create a companion that keeps you company while you work.", "Get Started"]
9: ["Desktop pet creation is underway. We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is live on screen.", "Feel free to use other apps while your desktop pet is prepared."]
